District.reason: District Line: No service between High Street Kensington and Edgware Road due to a points failure at Edgware Road. London Buses are accepting tickets via any reasonable route. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: Severe delays following a late finish of engineering work and due to an earlier points failure at Stratford. Tickets are being accepted on London buses, Mildmay line, Elizabeth line, DLR, C2C, Southeastern and Thameslink railway services via any reasonable route.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Severe delays between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Aldgate following a late finish of engineering work. London Buses are accepting tickets via any reasonable route. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Tuesday 11, Wednesday 12, Thursday 13 and Friday 14 August, the 0651 train from Stratford to Richmond will start from Acton Central at 0743.
